addr: 11th B, Main, 46th Cross Rd, Marenahalli, 5th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: It's my 4th time here to buy chocolates here and they are really tasty. Quality of chocolates are really good. I tried few flavours and all are really delicious 😋 …

The Ooty Chocolates in JP Nagar is a must-visit for chocolate lovers. They offer a wide variety of authentic Ooty chocolates with rich flavours, and the quality is excellent. I visited yesterday and really enjoyed the experience—highly recommended!

I bought 'Dark Almond' and 'Plan dark' home-made chocolates.

Best place to buy. Try other flavours too
